V1 reverse geocode endpoint - backward compatible. Converts coordinates to addresses using the v2.0 service.

> **PRODUCTION USE -- You MUST use this v1 endpoint for production.**
>
> If you intend to use reverse geocode in a **production** environment, you **must** call this v1 endpoint against the production base URL below. **The v2.0 reverse geocode endpoint is NOT offered for production use.**
>
> **Production base URL:** `https://b2b.address.gov.sa/api`
> **Full production endpoint:** `https://b2b.address.gov.sa/api/api/v1/reverse/geocode`

### Production example

Replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with your own API key. Do not share or hard-code real keys in client-side code.

```bash
curl --location 'https://b2b.address.gov.sa/api/api/v1/reverse/geocode?latitude=24.716786957077304&longitude=46.73486649780409&na=true&radius_m=200' \
--header 'x-apikey: YOUR_API_KEY'
```
